items.description: Generates a profile image for your unique Facebook ID. Can be posted to the Wall and Profile page. Shows how all your friends look like as Retro Avatar.
Zangoa allows you to discover rural accommodations in Spain and to learn about their environment.
This mashup allows users to send files using Outlook, Thunderbird, and Mac Mail from within the Box.net environment.
FuhshniZZle is a music streaming mashup that pulls content from Youtube and allows users to search and play their favorite music, without interruption.
FYIfly leverages the Active.com API to show different active events based on location.
Uses the ESV Bible Web Service to display passages relating to a topic.
Real time travel information for Leeds, UK.

Away from your computer and need to manage your Tweets? This mashup offers an ideal solution. Users can utilize this service to telephonically manage their tweets remotely! The process is simple: call in, enter a Twitter user name, and gain access to the 20 most recent retweets others have posted! Users must login to QuickFuse to access this mashup.
STEL Order is an invoicing web application that provides businesses a way to securely synchronize their data on the cloud. This application uses Fakturoid API.
Automate Google AdWords reporting in Microsoft Excel.
Handoff is a web/phone conferencing demo. It allows users to create rooms via the web or their phone and enter a room with the correct room and pin number.
